bounds_and_unmeasured: No actual 14-case or nine-case run directory exists; retained snapshot NPZ sizes, compression ratio, real logs and final complete proof size remain unmeasured. No production preparation/execution_review exists, so complete immutable/reviewer map size is unknown.

inventory_tree reads each file fully (256 MiB individual limit, 2 GiB cumulative content limit), with before/after identity checks. Each inventory hashes every file; it does not reuse hashes. Total cap is checked after reading the current file. Successful-tree content is <=2 GiB; failure can have read more before refusal.

Known 11 restore proof inventory passes per admission imply up to 22 GiB of successful-tree content reads at existing generic caps, not a realistic synthetic fixture size estimate. Do not allocate at that cap to measure.

Snapshot reviewer common.digest uses read_bytes, so its transient allocation includes the full individual file. No explicit snapshot-size cap is applied by that reader. Metadata must be checked before any future timing run.
Retained log revalidation hashes the entire original prefix and captured span, then rereads the saved span. Current log stat sizes do not establish future anchor offsets, drift, or exact replay cost.

For model snapshot M, attach costs one mandatory M pass; each resumed step costs at least three M passes before its action, and reconciliation adds one M pass. Original model metadata gives M=8,267,162,080 logical bytes; these are repeated userspace reads, not unique physical disk traffic.

Distinct paths can alias files; wheel RECORD has five repeated resolved-path entries here. OS filesystem cache, compressed memory, APFS clones, page residency, concurrent work and changes after stat can substantially alter actual I/O and timing. No cache flushing, cache policy change or validation weakening is proposed.
All conclusions describe the frozen disabled code. Both production execution flags stay false. Static cost evidence does not establish safe maintenance duration.

assumptions: One valid original preparation; exact prerequisites already accepted and retained; every validator reaches successful completion.
Fresh route is Host construction, one prepare_capture, one Controller.run, no failures, retries, recovery, extra standalone checks, or operator invocations.

Two stop_into_hold paths each call create_hold/arm_next_spawn/signal_stop/remove_held (8 mutations); install repair (1), bootstrap two services (2), apply provider restart (1), release two guards (2): 14 mutations.
Six witnesses: provider_drain, final_snapshot, backup, private_restore, startup, provider_ready.
Each of 14 mutations and six witness producers calls _allow once; private restore adds four runner barriers; controller preflight calls admission once: 14+6+4+1=25.
successful_fresh_scenario.limits: Conditional source-derived counts, not an executed trace or universal upper bound. Failed validation exits early. Future artifact maps, repeated refs, extra operator calls, or different recovery phases can add reads. No elapsed time, physical I/O, cache-hit, CPU, RSS, pressure or duration claim follows from these counts.
